errors.not_signed_in: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.csrf_token_missing_or_wrong: We could not confirm this action. Reload the page and try again.
errors.invalid_request: We could not send this information. Reload the page and try again.
errors.link_invalid: This link no longer works. Ask your office's owner for a new one.
errors.password_too_short: The password must be at least {{min}} characters.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again shortly.
errors.network: No connection to the server. Check your internet and try again.
errors.owner_only: Only the office's owner can do this.
errors.drive_not_configured: Connecting Google Drive is not available in this environment yet.
errors.drive_denied: The connection was cancelled at Google. Try again whenever you like.
errors.drive_link_invalid: This connection request has expired. Start again with Connect.
errors.drive_connect_failed: Google Drive could not be connected. Please try again shortly.
errors.drive_share_failed: The folder in your Drive could not be prepared. Nothing was changed; try again.

drive.intro: Project files live in the office's Google Drive. The portal only reaches files and folders it creates itself.
drive.notConnectedBody: Connecting creates a “Portal Clientes” folder in your Drive. Your files stay yours.
drive.openFolder: Open the folder in Google Drive
drive.expiredBody: Client pages stay up; uploads and new projects wait until you reconnect.
drive.readerProblem: The portal cannot read the folder. Check it was not moved or unshared.
drive.localBody: On this computer, projects use the local example folders.
drive.disconnectConfirm: The portal stops reaching your Drive now. Files stay in the folder.
drive.ownerOnly: Only the office's owner can connect or disconnect.
drive.noticeNone: Connect Google Drive to create projects and upload files from here.
drive.noticeExpired: The Google Drive connection expired. Client pages stay up; uploads and new projects wait until you reconnect.
